title: Non-Meet platforms (Zoom, Teams, Webex waiting rooms) count as admitted immediately, so the silence watchdog still reloads in their lobby
evidence: sb_join_loop.py: state='in-call' for any non-Meet URL, AdmissionState emits admitted on the first tick (assumed:true), timeout 0. record-commands.ts runs zoom/teams (strategy vexa, no Vexa deployed) through the same sb_join bot, and the repo fixture py/fixtures/inner.html carries the Zoom waiting-room text 'Please wait, the host will let you in soon'. A silent Zoom/Teams waiting room therefore triggers watchdog-reload after ~121 s, the same track-killing reload as ISS-CAPTUREFIX-001.
fix_direction: add per-platform lobby phrases/in-call DOM signals for Zoom and Teams (and Webex), or hold the watchdog for non-Meet platforms until a platform-specific admitted signal; keep a fixture per platform lobby.
